data.change_summary: No additional fixes were applied in this Apply Fixes stage. The latest review approved the round-9 budget-tracking amendments without follow-up changes, so the code remains as produced in the most recent implement stage.
outstanding_risks: The structural canonical-helper coverage guard remains convention-based rather than reflective; future explicit N/C-bearing fields with non-standard names or fields hidden in empty-by-default collections will require extending the discovery rules and tests.

Shrimp eggs remain implicit until hatch; mass is conserved through reserve-backed funding, but a future phase may still want an explicit egg or clutch biomass pool for clearer persistence and tracing.

Daily plant/algae "respiration" losses are currently modeled as particulate turnover into `fine_detritus_g_total`; if a later phase wants literal metabolic respiration with O2/DIC coupling, the parameter naming and routing will need to be revisited together.

Complex multi-process stages such as `system:nitrogen_cycle` still rely on snapshot-derived gross component budgets, so same-component turnover inside one stage can remain collapsed until those stages emit fully explicit source/sink deltas.
